cands.name: Jennifer Jonsson
cands.bio: Republican, first-term House member since Nov. 2024; born 1977 in Jacksonville; University of Florida degrees in public health (B.S. 2000, master's 2001). Lives in Polk County with her husband and three children.

record.text: Won the 2024 Republican primary with about 51%, then beat Democrat Ashley Herrmann; represents Polk County south of Lakeland (succeeded Melony Bell).
